_comment: position_offset values are in ArUco marker axis frame of reference

cups._comment: Sorting cups (blue=1, green=2, red=3). 35mm marker (full ArUco square incl. black border) on side wall, 39mm cup outer radius, 96.5mm cup body height, marker centered at 58.55% of cup height = 40mm below the top rim, marker mesh inset 6mm into cup wall. The marker_to_object block declares the geometry; aruco_camera_localizer's marker_geometry module computes the offset = (X=0, Y=-0.00825, Z=-0.033) m at runtime. Y is NEGATIVE here because the marker is now ABOVE cup body center (cup center is below the marker, so negative Y in marker frame). Mirrors soarm101-dt CUP_ARUCO_CONFIG.
